invalidation_reason: Assertions were redesigned on 2026-04-26. Previous results measured template conformity only (section names, frontmatter presence). New assertions measure capability (factual accuracy, anti-hallucination, cross-component tracing), behavior (clarification requests, read-before-spawn ordering, parallel agent spawning), and structure as a minority subset. Previous pass rates are not comparable. Re-run required.

previous_summary.note: These numbers only measured template conformity. A document with correct section names but wrong content would pass. The +0.66 delta was real but trivial — it proved the skill enforces its own template, not that it produces better research.

scenarios: Eval 1: Verifiable facts (agents used by create-plan)
Eval 3: Ambiguous prompt — should ask clarification
Eval 5: Explicit file read — ordering behavior
Eval 7: Agent architecture — parallel spawning + factual completeness
